translations.MenuWelcome: 👋 Albums bot Create albums of photos and videos and share them with a secret code. Got a code from a friend? Just send it to me.
translations.ErrorGeneric: ⚠️ Something went wrong. Please try again.
translations.ListSharedEmptyHint: Send me an access code to get started.
translations.ErrorAlbumNotOwned: Album not found or you are not its owner.
translations.AlbumTitleEmpty: Title can't be empty. Try again or /cancel.
translations.AlbumDeleteConfirm: Delete {0} and all its media references? This can't be undone.
translations.AlbumClosed: Album closed. Everyone else lost access.
translations.AlbumOpenedInfo: 🔓 {0} is open. Access code: {1} Link: https://t.me/{2}?start={1} Anyone with the code can watch the album (but not edit it). Closing the album invalidates the code and removes all viewers.
translations.JoinHint: Send me an access code to open an album, or use the menu.
translations.JoinThrottled: ⏳ Too many wrong codes. Please try again in a few minutes.
translations.JoinWrongCode: ❌ Wrong code, or the album is closed.
translations.AddOnlyMedia: Only photos and videos can be added. Press Done when finished.
translations.AddPrompt: 📥 Adding to {0}. Send or forward photos and videos – as many as you like. Nothing is saved until you press Done; duplicates are skipped automatically. Media you edit or delete before then is tracked.
translations.AddKeyboardHint: To finish adding, press the Done button below or the Done button on your keyboard.
translations.AddHintOpenAlbum: To add media, open one of your albums and press ➕ Add media.
translations.CardClosed: 🔒 Closed – only you can see it
translations.RemovePrompt: Type the numbers of the items to delete, e.g. 5, 1 2 3 or 1-3. Numbers are permanent — deleting items never renumbers the others. You will see a preview first and can cancel before anything is deleted. Don't know the numbers? Open the view with numbers.
translations.RemoveIgnored: ℹ️ {0} number(s) were not found and ignored.
translations.RemovePreview: 🗑 Preview – {0} Selected {1}, showing {2}–{3}. The numbers under the pictures are listed in picture order. Tap a number to keep it (↩) or to delete it again (🗑). Type other numbers to replace the selection. Will be deleted: {4} of {1}
translations.RemovePreviewFailed: ⚠️ {0} item(s) could not be shown (they can still be deleted).
translations.RemovePreviewExpired: This preview has expired. Start again from 🗑 Remove media.
translations.ViewNumbersHint: The numbers under the pictures are listed in the same order as the pictures (left to right, top to bottom). Numbers never change.
translations.ViewDeleteHint: 🗑 Type the number(s) to delete, e.g. 12, 12 15 18 or 12-15.
translations.ViewNoMatches: ⚠️ No items with those numbers (already deleted or never existed).
